name: Gucci Gang
tagline: Supplying quality Minnesota corn to businesses and processors.
about: Gucci Gang is a Minnesota-based grain supplier focused on sourcing quality corn from local farmers. We help connect farms with businesses and processors that need reliable corn supplies. Our goal is to provide quality products and dependable service.
how_to_order: Tell customers how to place an order with you. (The class will agree on a standard later; for now, write what you think works.)
